pp1.3:6.1: arukūpamacitto puggalo, vijjūpamacitto puggalo, vajirūpamacitto puggalo. 6.
pp1.3:8.1: avakujjapañño puggalo, ucchaṅga pañño puggalo, puthupañño puggalo. 8.
pp1.3:9.1: atth' ekacco puggalo kāmesu ca bhavesu ca avītarāgo, atth' ekacco puggalo kāmesu vītarāgo bhavesu avītarāgo, atth' ekacco puggalo kāmesu ca bhavesu vītarāgo. 9.
pp1.3:10.1: pāsāṇalekhūpamo puggalo, paṭhavīlekhūpamo puggalo, udakalekhūpamo puggalo. 10.
pp1.3:14.1: atth' ekacco puggalo na sevitabbo, na bhajitabbo, na payirupāsitabbo; atth' ekacco puggalo sevitabbo, bhajitabbo, payirupāsitabbo; atth' ekacco puggalo sakkatvā garuṅkatvā sevitabbo, bhajitabbo, payirupāsitabbo. 14.
pp1.3:15.1: atth' ekacco puggalo jigucchitabbo, na sevitabbo, na bhajitabbo, na payirupāsitabbo; atth' ekacco puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo, na bhajitabbo, na payirupāsitabbo;
pp1.3:15.2: atth' ekacco puggalo sevitabbo, bhajitabbo, payirūpāsitabbo. 15.
pp1.3:16.1: atth' ekacco puggalo sīlesu paripūrakārī samādhismiṃ mattasokārī paññāya mattasokārī;
pp1.3:16.2: atth' ekacco puggalo sīlesu ca paripūrakārī samādhismiñca paripūrakārī paññāya mattasokārī;
pp1.3:16.3: atth' ekacco puggalo sīlesu ca paripūrakārī samādhismiñ ca paripūrakārī paññāya ca paripūrakārī. 16.
